The best pro-side evidence is only that elections and some opposition candidacies still existed in formal terms, but they operated inside a tightly managed, repressive system.","evidence":[{"title":"Russians vote in tightly controlled regional elections","publisher":"Reuters","date":"7 Sep 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russians-vote-in-tightlycontrolled-regional-elections-first-since-war-began-3169837","summary":"Russia still held regional and local elections in 2023, but Reuters described them as tightly controlled, with opposition figures cowed or blocked and the Kremlin going to unusual lengths to avoid upsets.
